== Build notes ==
Magazine dest 23 October 2026. Pages 113–114 from Internet Archive item DragonMagazine260_201801 (PDF leaves 115–116). Transcription from the opened scans. Product heading on page 113; review body on page 114. Alternate Universe is the paired product in the same review block.

== Possibly faulty data ==
The wrap on page 114 prints "Star Wars role-playing tame)". The scan reads tame.

== Marginal cuts ==
The column bio on page 115 prints a Des Moines street address; omitted. DarkStryder Campaign and Don't Look Back in the same Role-playing Reviews column are separate product reviews. No SWCCG advertisement in this issue.
